title: Quantum metrology via mitigation of single-photon loss using an engineered nonlinear oscillator
summary: The fragility of quantum metrological advantages under loss remains a major barrier to practical quantum sensing. For a two-photon-driven (TPD) Kerr resonator (TPD-Kerr model) subject to unavoidable single-photon loss (SPL), both the quantum Fisher information gain and squeezing level exhibit hard-to-track long-lived damped oscillations, restricting useful sensing and squeezing to extremely short time windows.
